svg.text: Real-time Chat Platform | Microservices | Go + Python + Next.js
API Gateway | Reverse Proxy | Load Balancer | Path/Header Routing | ForwardAuth
NexusChat | Tuananh165-art | Docker Compose | Traefik | Go 1.24 | Python 3.12 | Next.js 15
Kafka 7.6.0 | Redis Cluster 8.2.1 | Cassandra 4.0 | PostgreSQL 16 | MinIO | Prometheus | Jaeger
Auth: JWT cookie (user) | ForwardAuth middleware (uploader -> chat /api/chat/forwardauth) | Channel-level authorization
gRPC service-id headers for routing | Traefik path-based routing | Redis cluster password auth
